tools.name: Karin Beta-replacement builder (build_hfw.py and modules)
tools.role: VRM fitting (body TPS, per-bone hand maps), culling, region weight transfer, borrowed PBD particle weights (skirt, twin tails, tail), facial rig weights on skeleton 719 (face_hfw.py), texture pages and h2 ascii writing

tools.name: make_mod.py / patch_bounds.py
tools.role: DDS conversion, h2 import runs with success counts, core bounds and SkinInfo patch

tools.name: h2_pc_mi_091 (id-daemon)
tools.role: export of vanilla meshes/skeletons and import of ascii meshes and DDS textures into core/stream files

tools.name: DirectXTex texconv
tools.role: BC1 / BC7 / BC6H_UF16 conversion for the fixed-size texture slots

tools.name: HFW Mod Manager (KingJulz)
tools.role: Pack Mods and the Characters swap to Beta; not called by the scripts

runtime_boundary: Karin_Original 1.1.0 (2026-10-24): finger fix confirmed by the user in cutscenes (1.0.1); skirt, twin-tail and tail sway on borrowed PBD particles accepted by the user in game; facial expressions checked by the agent in photo mode; dialogue lip sync, combat, climbing and distant body LODs unchecked; no blinking and no long-chain hair physics.
